target_customer: Consumers, mostly young users, who want to play characters inside AI-driven social worlds; revenue from in-app purchases and subscriptions is not confirmed by a source I opened
problem: Social media is passive for fans of fictional universes. Status lets users create a persona and act inside an AI-simulated social feed of any story world.
business_model: Consumer mobile app; monetization not stated in sources opened
product_category: AI social role-play and gamified social network

founders.name: Fai Nur
previous_startups: WishRoll (co-founded; Status is built by WishRoll)
founders.background_notes: YC page describes her as CEO and co-founder of WishRoll. TechCrunch says she was a chronically online teenager who saw AI as a way to live inside stories. Education and prior employers not found in sources opened.

founders.name: Amit Bhatnagar
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder by TechCrunch (May 2026), which says he grew up building Minecraft games.

founders.name: Pritesh Kadiwala
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder by TechCrunch (May 2026); a company architecture article attributed to him suggests an engineering role, not opened in detail.

competitors.name: Character.AI
competitors.what: Chat with AI characters, ex-Google LaMDA founders
competitors.traction_then: Public beta opened 2022-09-16; hundreds of thousands of interactions in first three weeks per Oct 2022 press

technical_complexity.rationale: Product relies on third-party LLMs and a social-feed simulation at consumer scale; the hard part is cost and latency at millions of users, not novel research.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar AI role-play apps exist and the underlying models are rented. Created worlds and character profiles (13M worlds, 5M profiles per TechCrunch 2026) give some content lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: As of May 2026 TechCrunch contrasts Status with first-generation apps like Character.AI and Chai; no incumbent had absorbed the wedge in sources found.

market_need_then: At the 2022 batch the AI character category was just forming; the demand evidence is later (public launch growth and TechCrunch 2026 traction numbers). Contemporaneous 2022 evidence of demand was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses statusai.com rather than status.com; the plain word is held by other companies (e.g. the Ethereum messenger Status).

identity.visual_style: App store and web tagline 'Be anyone in your own world'

branding.community_and_virality: Company links a Discord server and a Twitter account; a 2024 PocketGamer.biz headline reports a million-user simulation in a month, and Business Insider listed it as a startup to watch (2025 and 2026 per YC page).

brand_strength.rationale: Growth press exists but the generic word name is shared with other products and the brand pages found are thin.

outcome_analysis: Status is active and announced a 17M combined seed and Series A in May 2026 from General Catalyst, USV and others, claiming 13M worlds created. It rode the generative AI wave after 2022, with the idea taking shape after ChatGPT launched. Long-term risk is model cost and fast-following AI role-play apps.
notes: Outcome search found no shutdown or layoffs for Status AI (results were unrelated products). Round is called combined seed and Series A by TechCrunch and an aggregator, so stage is other. Character.AI source is dated about six months after the batch. Earlier WishRoll apps (Kiwi) and Status's 2024 public launch were seen only in search snippets and are not recorded as facts beyond that.
